# apple_beta_tester (Data Source)

Looks up a beta tester by App Store Connect ID or email.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_beta_tester" "ann" {
  email = "ann@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email address of the tester, in any case. Set this or `id`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the tester. Set this or `email`.

### Read-Only

- `first_name` (String) First name of the tester.
- `invite_type` (String) How the tester was invited: `EMAIL` or `PUBLIC_LINK`.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the tester.
- `state` (String) State of the tester's invitation.
